# LoadUp Components SpringDoc

提供 OpenAPI 与 Knife4j 的自动配置。

## 引入

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-springdoc</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

## 装配与配置

模块提供以下自动配置入口；实际启用条件和配置项以对应类及父模块 README 为准：

- `SpringDocAutoConfiguration`

## 设计

内部边界、依赖与源码入口见 [ARCHITECTURE.md](../springdoc-architecture/)。

## 接入步骤


## 配置入口

| 前缀 | 配置类 |
|---|---|
| `loadup.springdoc` | [`SpringDocProperties`](https://github.com/loadup-cloud/loadup-framework/blob/main/loadup-components/loadup-components-springdoc/src/main/java/io/github/loadup/components/springdoc/properties/SpringDocProperties.java) |

## 自动装配

- [`SpringDocAutoConfiguration`](https://github.com/loadup-cloud/loadup-framework/blob/main/loadup-components/loadup-components-springdoc/src/main/java/io/github/loadup/components/springdoc/autoconfigure/SpringDocAutoConfiguration.java)
  - 启用条件：`@ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = "loadup.springdoc", name = "enabled", havingValue = "true", matchIfMissing = true)`。
